title: Medicare Part A vs Part B: What Is Actually Free and What Costs Money
bigPicture: Medicare Part A is usually free and Part B usually costs a monthly fee.
whatYouNeedToKnow: Part A covers hospital stays and most doctor visits and is free for most people.
Part B covers doctor visits, tests and supplies and you pay a monthly premium.
You can have both parts and pay only the Part B premium.
commonMistakesToAvoid: Assuming Part A has no costs at all even if you didn't work enough years.
Thinking Part B is optional and ignoring the monthly fee.
actionSteps: Check your Part A eligibility by looking at your work history or asking Social Security.
Sign up for Part B when you first become eligible to avoid late fees.
